profile.reportScope1: When "Show my business details in my reports" is on, the details you select are added to these Word reports: Client Journey, Numerology analysis, Classical Numerology and Nutrition plan. The details appear on the cover, in the signature section at the end of the report and in the page footer; the legal notice text stays unchanged.
profile.reportScope2: In Human Design reports your name is not written automatically; only if the "Prepared by" field in the report is filled are your title and organisation (and, in the professional report, your logo) added; contact details and the footnote are not added.
profile.reportScope3: In Reflexology, Cupping (protocol and calendar) and Celestial Atlas (Word and PDF) reports, when the switch is on, a "Prepared by" signature section is added at the end of the report; your name is not written automatically, only the title, organisation, contact details, logo and footnote you select appear.
profile.reportScope4: In the Hijama report (Word and PDF) the "Prepared by" name in the form stays as it is and is not replaced with your profile name; if this field is filled, only your title, organisation and logo are added; contact details and the footnote are not added.
profile.reportScope5: Encyclopaedias, lecture notes, stock and archive exports are not covered. While the switch is off, no report changes.

profile.brandingDescription: While off, your reports are produced as they are today. When you turn it on, the details you select below are added to the reports listed above.
